input_value: You come first when you work with me! With my proven negotiating and marketing skills you have me in your corner in every step of the home buying and selling process. My real estate career started in 1993 with a small company that had a very experienced owner. He trained me from the start to always put my clients needs first and to be the best Realtor I could be by absorbing as much knowledge as I could from experienced agents and reading many books about real estate sales, client service, negotiating skills, etc. After several years I took this knowledge and opened my own company. I trained many agents to succeed and enjoyed mentoring them. I joined RE/MAX in 2017. I have a great team of local lenders and home inspectors and my relationship with the best title companies in the state provides my clients the best services available. I am part of Real Estate For Life, which is a national non-profit organization that donates part of my commissions to pro life causes. With my years of experience in working with other agents, lenders, home inspectors, buyers, sellers, foreclosures, short sales, etc and having an expert knowledge of the metro Denver housing market, you will have a real estate sales experience second to none!

My real estate career started in 1993 with a small company that had a very experienced owner. He trained me from the start to always put my clients needs first and to be the best Realtor I could be by absorbing as much knowledge as I could from experienced agents and reading many books about real estate sales, client service, negotiating skills, etc. After several years I took this knowledge and opened my own company. I trained many agents to succeed and enjoyed mentoring them. I joined RE/MAX in 2017. I have a great team of local lenders and home inspectors and my relationship with the best title companies in the state provides my clients the best services available. I am part of Real Estate For Life, which is a national non-profit organization that donates part of my commissions to pro life causes. With my years of experience in working with other agents, lenders, home inspectors, buyers, sellers, foreclosures, short sales, etc and having an expert knowledge of the metro Denver housing market, you will have a real estate sales experience second to none.

Studio Fratesco is dedicated to design that is both timeless and visionary, drawing upon the classical principles of beauty as articulated by St. Thomas Aquinas: claritas (radiance and intelligibility), consonantia (harmony and proportion), and integritas (wholeness and perfection). These enduring ideals shape our approach, guiding the creation of work that is not only visually compelling but also intellectually and spiritually resonant.

Traditional. Visionary.—this is more than a design philosophy; it reflects the spirit of our patron, Friar Girolamo Savonarola, who called the Church back to her foundations while boldly envisioning her renewal. Whether in editorial, branding, or digital design, each project is crafted with depth and intentionality, uniting tradition with innovation. By drawing from the richness of history and applying it to contemporary mediums, we seek to create work that endures, inspires, and elevates.

Alexander Norton, Founder and Creative Director, founded Studio Fratesco in 2022 in Florence, Italy, drawing inspiration from the city’s artistic heritage—where the sacred brush of Fra Angelico, the chisel of Donatello, and the talent and vision of Botticelli, Michelangelo, and Brunelleschi shaped a tradition of beauty that endures to this day.

He has collaborated with institutions such as the Pontifical University of St. Thomas Aquinas (Angelicum), The Thomistic Institute, Arouca Press, Oxford University,  . His recent projects include editorial design for Angelicum: Historic Renovations, branding for The Thomistic Institute, and the publication of Kenosis for the Servants of Christ Jesus. Through his work, he seeks to elevate design beyond aesthetics, creating work that endures, inspires, and speaks to the intellect and soul.

description:
Studio Fratesco is dedicated to design that is both timeless and visionary, drawing upon the classical principles of beauty as articulated by St. Thomas Aquinas: claritas (radiance and intelligibility), consonantia (harmony and proportion), and integritas (wholeness and perfection). These enduring ideals shape our approach, guiding the creation of work that is not only visually compelling but also intellectually and spiritually resonant.

Traditional. Visionary.—this is more than a design philosophy; it reflects the spirit of our patron, Friar Girolamo Savonarola, who called the Church back to her foundations while boldly envisioning her renewal. Whether in editorial, branding, or digital design, each project is crafted with depth and intentionality, uniting tradition with innovation. By drawing from the richness of history and applying it to contemporary mediums, we seek to to elevate design beyond aesthetics, creating work that endures, inspires, and speaks to the intellect and soul.

Alexander Norton, Founder and Creative Director, founded Studio Fratesco in 2022 in Florence, Italy, drawing inspiration from the city’s artistic heritage—where the sacred brush of Fra Angelico, the chisel of Donatello, and the talent and vision of Botticelli, Michelangelo, and Brunelleschi shaped a tradition of beauty that endures to this day.

He has collaborated with institutions such as the Pontifical University of St. Thomas Aquinas (Angelicum), The Thomistic Institute, Arouca Press, Oxford University, and Eternal Christendom, to name a few.

description:
Studio Fratesco is dedicated to design that is both timeless and visionary, drawing upon the classical principles of beauty as articulated by St. Thomas Aquinas: claritas (radiance and intelligibility), consonantia (harmony and proportion), and integritas (wholeness and perfection). These enduring ideals shape our approach, guiding the creation of work that is not only visually compelling but also intellectually and spiritually resonant.

Traditional. Visionary.—this is more than a design philosophy; it reflects the spirit of our patron, Friar Girolamo Savonarola, who called the Church back to her foundations while boldly envisioning her renewal. Whether in editorial, branding, or digital design, each project is crafted with depth and intentionality, uniting tradition with innovation. By drawing from the richness of history and applying it to contemporary mediums, we seek to to elevate design beyond aesthetics, creating work that endures, inspires, and speaks to the intellect and soul.

Alexander Norton, Founder and Creative Director, founded Studio Fratesco in 2022 in Florence, Italy, drawing inspiration from the city’s artistic heritage—where the sacred brush of Fra Angelico, the chisel of Donatello, and the talent and vision of Botticelli, Michelangelo, and Brunelleschi shaped a tradition of beauty that endures to this day.

He has collaborated with institutions such as the Pontifical University of St. Thomas Aquinas (Angelicum), The Thomistic Institute, Arouca Press, Oxford University, and Eternal Christendom, to name a few.

Our Mission - Through authentic relationships built on sincerity and humility, we analyze customer and employee interactions to cultivate a culture where service is a consistent joy.

- World-Class Monitoring & Accreditation: Elevate your customer service experience with certifications like "It’s a BLAST to SERVE™." Gain insights from real-time feedback andactionable monthly reports.

2. Leadership Development:
- Background Leadership 101™: Cultivate servant leadership among executives and managers with hands-on training and personalized coaching.
- Background Leadership Certification™: Advanced coaching and skill-building for leaders to master servant leadership techniques.

3. Individual Customer Service Certification:
- It’s a BLAST to SERVE™ Certification: Equip your team with de-escalation techniques and best practices for daily interactions.
- SERVE-ing Beside Christ™ Certification: Specialized training tailored for church environments, combining prayer and practical service strategies.

4. A La Carte Services:
- Customer, employee, and event satisfaction surveys
- Net Promoter Score (NPS) assessments
 -Customizable feedback systems

Why Choose Us?
- Customized Solutions: Tailored programs to meet your organization’s unique needs.
- In-Person Expertise: We work directly with your team to ensure impactful results.
- Proven Results: Accredited by BBB and committed to achieving measurable outcomes for your business.

Office Rebel provides hands-on, executive-level office support to small businesses, Catholic organizations, and independent professionals across Colorado’s mountain communities. Whether you're managing a team, launching a retreat, or just trying to get through the paperwork, I bring decades of experience, and an old-school work ethic, to make your job easier.

As a Catholic convert and member of the Body of Christ, I believe in doing good work, serving others with integrity, and honoring the dignity of every client and employee. I offer faithful support for faith-driven businesses.

 CORE SERVICES INCLUDE:

EXECUTIVE & ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT
Calendar + inbox management, travel planning, documents, errands, and project organization. done with precision and reliability.

HUMAN RESOURCES + HANDBOOKS
Onboarding help, policy documents, job postings, compliance support, without the overhead of hiring full-time staff.

IN-PERSON ASSISTANCE & MOUNTAIN MOBILITY
From Evergreen to Vail and Steamboat to Salida, I bring real support to small towns that need it, clipboard in hand, ready to work.

Catholic-Owned & Christ-Centered

Grounded in traditional values and raised in a family business, I understand the mission behind your work. I proudly offer a 10% discount to members of the Colorado Catholic Business Network.

description:
Office Rebel provides hands-on, executive-level office support to small businesses, Catholic organizations, and independent professionals across Colorado’s mountain communities. Whether you're managing a team, launching a retreat, or just trying to get through the paperwork, I bring decades of experience, and an old-school work ethic, to make your job easier.

As a Catholic convert and member of the Body of Christ, I believe in doing good work, serving others with integrity, and honoring the dignity of every client and employee. I offer faithful support for faith-driven businesses.

 CORE SERVICES INCLUDE:

EXECUTIVE & ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT
Calendar + inbox management, travel planning, documents, errands, and project organization. done with precision and reliability.

HUMAN RESOURCES + HANDBOOKS
Onboarding help, policy documents, job postings, compliance support, without the overhead of hiring full-time staff.

IN-PERSON ASSISTANCE & MOUNTAIN MOBILITY
From Evergreen to Vail and Steamboat to Salida, I bring real support to small towns that need it, clipboard in hand, ready to work.

Catholic-Owned & Christ-Centered

Grounded in traditional values and raised in a family business, I understand the mission behind your work. I proudly offer a 10% discount to members of the Colorado Catholic Business Network.

If you’re ready to create a website that works as hard as you do, let’s talk.

description:
Office Rebel provides hands-on, executive-level office support to small businesses, Catholic organizations, and independent professionals across Colorado’s mountain communities. Whether you're managing a team, launching a retreat, or just trying to get through the paperwork, I bring decades of experience, and an old-school work ethic, to make your job easier.

As a Catholic convert and member of the Body of Christ, I believe in doing good work, serving others with integrity, and honoring the dignity of every client and employee. I offer faithful support for faith-driven businesses.

 CORE SERVICES INCLUDE:

EXECUTIVE & ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT
Calendar + inbox management, travel planning, documents, errands, and project organization. done with precision and reliability.

HUMAN RESOURCES + HANDBOOKS
Onboarding help, policy documents, job postings, compliance support, without the overhead of hiring full-time staff.

IN-PERSON ASSISTANCE & MOUNTAIN MOBILITY
From Evergreen to Vail and Steamboat to Salida, I bring real support to small towns that need it, clipboard in hand, ready to work.

Catholic-Owned & Christ-Centered

Grounded in traditional values and raised in a family business, I understand the mission behind your work. I proudly offer a 10% discount to members of the Colorado Catholic Business Network.

description:
Office Rebel provides hands-on, executive-level office support to small businesses, Catholic organizations, and independent professionals across Colorado’s mountain communities. Whether you're managing a team, launching a retreat, or just trying to get through the paperwork, I bring decades of experience, and an old-school work ethic, to make your job easier.

As a Catholic convert and member of the Body of Christ, I believe in doing good work, serving others with integrity, and honoring the dignity of every client and employee. I offer faithful support for faith-driven businesses.

 CORE SERVICES INCLUDE:

EXECUTIVE & ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT
Calendar + inbox management, travel planning, documents, errands, and project organization. done with precision and reliability.

HUMAN RESOURCES + HANDBOOKS
Onboarding help, policy documents, job postings, compliance support, without the overhead of hiring full-time staff.

IN-PERSON ASSISTANCE & MOUNTAIN MOBILITY
From Evergreen to Vail and Steamboat to Salida, I bring real support to small towns that need it, clipboard in hand, ready to work.

Catholic-Owned & Christ-Centered

Grounded in traditional values and raised in a family business, I understand the mission behind your work. I proudly offer a 10% discount to members of the Colorado Catholic Business Network.
